7510.title: Installed catalog metadata repeats screenshot validation warnings
7510.rootCauseOneLine: Every installed-plugin list re-resolves catalog screenshots with a live warning callback, outside the manifest parse cache.
7510.proposedFix: Keep screenshot validation warnings at marketplace materialization; make catalog metadata reads side-effect-free by removing their warning callback.
7510.caveats: Reproduced through the real plugin service and migrated SQLite database, not a packaged macOS UI. Historical log-volume and retention percentages were not independently measured. Both clean runs were performed by the same agent.
